name: @pipeworx/mcp-openverse

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: "Find royalty-free / Creative Commons / public-domain images of [X]" / "CC images of [Y]" / "free-to-use pictures of [topic]" / "stock photos of [subject]" — search Creative-Commons-licensed images across Wikimedia, Flickr, Met Museum, Smithsonian, and many other open repositories via Openverse. Filter by license (cc0, by, by-sa, …), commercial-use, size. Use to find legally-reusable images for slides, blog posts, marketing, education.

tools.name: search_audio
tools.description: "Find royalty-free / Creative Commons / public-domain audio for [X]" / "free music / sound effects of [Y]" / "CC-licensed audio" — search Creative-Commons-licensed audio (music, sound effects, podcast clips) via Openverse. Filter by license, source. Use for video/podcast/game soundtracks that need legal reuse.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a single Openverse image record by UUID (license, attribution, source, dimensions). Use after `search_images` for licensing details.

tools.name: get_audio
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a single Openverse audio record by UUID (license, duration, attribution, source). Use after `search_audio` for licensing details.

tools.name: image_related
tools.description: "Find images similar to [X]" / "more images like this" — related images for a given Openverse image ID. Use for visual-similarity exploration in CC content.

tools.name: audio_related
tools.description: "Find audio similar to [X]" / "more sounds like this" — related audio for a given Openverse audio ID. Use for similarity exploration in CC audio.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openverse forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openverse pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
